messages:
kelly_cs: Heads-up — Silverbar cutover in 8 hours. Two items popped in preflight: (1) our log shipper is failing with KMS errors when trying to encrypt envelopes using the customers key (they said the key is cross-region), and (2) their audit bucket has a Compliance-mode Object Lock + legal hold on the delivery prefix, causing PutObject 403s. Need triage + low-risk go-live plan. :warning:

silverbar-infra: Thanks Kelly. Error we see on our side: `AccessDenied: User: arn:aws:sts::999900001111:assumed-role/silverbar-privdeploy is not authorized to perform: kms:Encrypt on arn:aws:kms:eu-west-1:222233334444:key/5f6a7b8c` — note key is in eu-west-1 while our forwarder is in us-west-2. We attempted to use alias `alias/silverbar-logs` but alias points to the eu key.

nova_neteng: Cross-region CMK is allowed but needs explicit key policy permissions and the service path sometimes trips up if CloudTrail/CloudWatch tries to SSE with a regional principal. Also ensure any S3 put includes the correct `x-amz-server-side-encryption-aws-kms-key-id` header referencing the eu key ARN.

arjun_kms: Two immediate checks: (A) key policy must allow our assumed role principal (sts ARN) and the cross-region usage, (B) if they used an alias that maps to an EU key, our shipper must set encryption headers and our KMS client must be configured to call eu-west-1 for that key. For quick mitigation I can propose creating a short-lived grant on the EU CMK for the exact assumed-role ARN, scoped with EncryptionContextSubset to `team=Silverbar` and `env=privdeploy`. Grants are region-aware so we'll need to run the grant targeting the EU key from their account.

mira_sec: Security note: Compliance-mode Object Lock + Legal Hold is non-negotiable for audit retention. We cannot request s3:BypassGovernanceRetention. Option: have them create a separate delivery prefix/bucket that is not under legal hold for the cutover window, or allow a scoped PutObject policy for our exact assumed-role ARN on a new prefix. Any change must be audited and short-lived.

onboard-bot: Reminder  Silverbar onboarding ticket #SB-442 targets go-live in 8h. Please record blocking actions on ticket.

kelly_cs: Proposed immediate plan: 1) Silverbar infra to confirm whether they can create `s3://silverbar-audit/temp/redwood/` not under legal hold (fastest), 2) if not possible, Arjun to provide `aws kms create-grant` command for the EU key we can ask their operator to run, 3) Nova to confirm our shipper can call EU region for the key (config patch) and provide runbook. Also capture renewal risk if they require separate delivery buckets for compliance: "additional storage contract". Acks?

silverbar-infra: We can spin up a temp prefix in 10-15m but legal requires a ticket to justify exceptions; creating a new prefix not under object lock is allowed. We'll do that now and update SB-442.

arjun_kms: Draft grant I'll paste to SB-442 once you confirm the key-id and grantee ARN. Example (they run in their account): `aws kms create-grant --key-id arn:aws:kms:eu-west-1:222233334444:key/5f6a7b8c --grantee-principal arn:aws:sts::999900001111:assumed-role/silverbar-privdeploy --operations Encrypt GenerateDataKey --constraints EncryptionContextSubset={"team":"Silverbar","env":"privdeploy"}`. We'll also include revoke instructions.

nova_neteng: On our side, shipper config change is trivial: set KMS region to eu-west-1 for alias `alias/silverbar-logs` and ensure we pass the `x-amz-server-side-encryption-aws-kms-key-id` header when calling S3. I'll paste the config diff to the ticket. Note: this requires a short restart of the forwarder (planned during cutover).

mira_sec: I'll prepare the audit trail blurb for SB-442 documenting why the temp prefix is approved and that it will be removed/archived and the action owner. Also logging a renewal risk note: "Customers with compliance object-lock patterns may require delivery-managed workflows; consider recommending Dedicated or managed logging add-on."

kelly_cs: Great. If they confirm prefix creation I'll ask them to update the trail destination and we'll do a small write test. If they can't create prefix within 20m we proceed with the grant path. Timestamps: please update SB-442 when done.

silverbar-infra: Prefix created: `silverbar-audit/redwood-temp/` and retention unset. Updated SB-442 with IAM excerpt.

arjun_kms: Copy that. I'll hold off on the grant. Nova, once you post the shipper config diff we'll schedule a 5-min restart and run a write test to `redwood-temp/`.

nova_neteng: Pushed config diff to SB-442 and scheduled restart at T-45m. Restart will rotate the KMS client to eu-west-1 for that key alias.

onboard-bot: Suggested next step  run a single PutObject test to `s3://silverbar-audit/redwood-temp/test-log` and report status.

kelly_cs: Everyone please paste test result to SB-442. I'll mark this as blocked->in-progress and close the gating action when test passes. Thanks team! :white_check_mark:
